free_tier.stated: Free model endpoints on select open-source models, including DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 70B and Llama 3.3 70B Instruct Turbo, after account creation with no card required; the vendor's own pricing docs put current per-model input/output rates in the console Model Hub rather than on a public page, so no free token quota is stated.
free_tier.notes: The vendor blog names the free models but states no token or request allowance; the rate-limit doc states a Tier 1 default of 1,000,000 TPM for all models and ties higher tiers to credit purchases. A USD 5 instant credit is reported by third parties for adding a card, but the vendor blog describes the free endpoints as requiring no card; the credit is not the free models and is not asserted here.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is tokens served by an inference endpoint, not a stored object
per_object_cap.notes: Inference Storage holds inputs and outputs, but no per-object cap is published on the pages read.

retention.stated: unverified: no retention window is stated for inference inputs or outputs on the pages read
retention.notes: Serverless endpoints scale to zero with no idle compute charge; what happens to request logs or stored artifacts after a call is not stated.

egress.terms: unverified: no egress allowance, price or quota for inference response bytes is stated on the pages read; serverless billing is per token and dedicated endpoints bill per GPU-hour

interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible REST API; GET /v1/models lists models and Bearer API-key auth is required. Dedicated endpoints are private-network deployments with no rate limits.
tooling: OpenAI-compatible SDKs and HTTP clients; models.dev lists the provider as package @ai-sdk/openai-compatible with 17 models.
chaining: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint swaps in with a base-URL change; free endpoints benchmark production H100/H200 behaviour, and paid serverless uses the same API, so a workload can move from free to paid without changing code.

limits.value: 1,000,000 TPM on Tier 1 for all models; Tier 2 3,000,000 TPM after USD 50 purchased, Tier 3 50,000,000 after USD 500, Tier 4 100,000,000 after USD 1,000; video models are limited in RPH
an account and an API key are required: GET /v1/models answered 401 with {"group":"api_key","message":"API key is required."} on a keyless request

limits_note: Rate limits are enforced at the organization level and vouchers do not count toward purchase for tier upgrades; dedicated endpoints have no rate limits, with the cap set by the hardware provisioned.
binding_note: On the free endpoint the 1,000,000-token-per-minute Tier 1 ceiling binds before any byte quota, because no free token allowance or egress cap is published and the next tier needs a credit purchase.

identity_cost.detail: The console sign-up form asks for email and password and offers Google, GitHub and Hugging Face sign-in; the free model endpoints are stated to need no credit card, only account creation. The measured keyless GET /v1/models answered 401 API key is required, so a key from the account is needed to call the API.

reliability_note: Keyless GET /v1/models returned 401 (API key is required) and GET /v1 returned 405 on 2026-11-24; rate limits are enforced per organization and tier upgrades need credit purchases, with vouchers excluded.
confidence_note: The free models, no-card claim, signup fields, per-token billing, API endpoint and rate limits were read from first-party pages on 2026-11-24; a keyless probe confirmed the API-key gate, but no token allowance or egress term is published, so those fields are marked unverified.

evidence.quote: Available free models include DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 70B and Llama 3.3 70B Instruct Turbo, accessible through an OpenAI-compatible API with no credit card required and no signup friction beyond account creation.

notes: Free model endpoints exist on select open-source models with no card, but neither a free token allowance nor an egress term is published; the binding limit is the Tier 1 rate cap and the account/API-key gate. The vendor's public pricing page prices GPU compute, not inference tokens, and the inference pricing doc defers rates to the console. A USD 5 card credit reported by third parties is a separate paid on-ramp and is not asserted as the free tier.
